name: Mega Man Classic Bar-Racer
tagline: Mirror-chrome front torpedo bar, TIG T-collar, 5-ribbed dish wheels & twin boosters
description: Faithful 4-wheel go-kart evolution of the iconic BakersfieldQuake Mega Man contraption: a gleaming mirror-chrome bullet-nosed front silver torpedo bar (with ribbed black rubber rear cap) clamped by a TIG-welded stainless T-collar to the front cross-axle, swept stainless twin perimeter rails, 4 iconic 5-ribbed pneumatic tires on concave off-white steel dish rims with zinc hex nuts, yellow cotter pins & brass Schrader valves, an off-white & Mega-Man-cobalt-blue ribbed seat, stainless T-steering column, and twin rear chrome rocket boosters.
highlights: Mirror-chrome bullet-nosed torpedo bar (X=+11..+54) w/ rubber cap & TIG T-collar
5-ribbed pneumatic tires on off-white dish rims w/ hex nuts, cotter pins & valves
Twin chrome rocket nozzles, 22x28u clear seated torso box & open footwell
